MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The VELCRO felt useful for removable mounting of small project components, a clear connection to my earlier reclosable fasteners.",
    "Mounting supplies connect with my assembly purchases when they serve a specific purpose in a small project."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another infrared thermometer offers no clear benefit when I already have an Etekcity 1080.",
    "Permanent epoxy, plumbing putty, cutting wheels, and layout fluid assume repair or metalworking needs that my purchases do not establish.",
    "Eighteen rolls of tape and twelve packs of glue are more than I need for occasional small projects."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics and assembly purchases seem to have been interpreted as interest in general workshop supplies, even when their uses differ substantially.",
    "Having bought a thermometer seems to have been taken as a reason to want another, without a clear new purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My breadboards, relay, wires, and connectors point toward small electronics projects where component compatibility and a specific function matter.",
    "Removable fastening fits my earlier mounting choice more closely than permanent bonding does.",
    "I choose supplies when I have a concrete use for them; general usefulness alone does not make me want to buy them now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my hands-on project interests but stretched them into broad workshop needs, with removable mounting providing the clearest match."
}
